title: 仰角
standfirst: 楼的长边向天空收拢，屋檐隔着亮处相遇。近处的建筑，在抬头以后改变了形状。
standfirstEn: Building edges converge towards the sky; eaves meet across an opening of light. Looking up changes the shape of what stands nearby.
introduction: 抬头以后，街面退到画外。楼的长边向同一个方向收拢，天空从建筑之间显出来。在另一幅里，阶梯、斜撑与弧顶层层叠上去，光从头顶穿过。
八幅照片保留了站在近处观看的角度：墙面折成棱线，屋檐隔着天空相遇，窗与梁架再把亮处分成小块。最后一道桥底向远处收窄，高处的结构落回河岸。地方改变，视线一直向上。
introductionEn: Looking up leaves the street outside the frame. Long edges converge and sky appears between buildings. Elsewhere, stairs and diagonal supports overlap beneath a curved roof, with light entering from above.

Eight photographs retain a view from close by. Walls form edges, eaves face one another across the sky, and windows and beams divide the light. At the end, the underside of a bridge narrows towards the riverbank. The places change; the view remains upward.

chapters.title: 棱线
chapters.text: 红墙与玻璃向天空折转，重复的窗格沿边缘收拢。近处的转角，在仰视中显得更长。
chapters.textEn: Brick and glass turn towards the sky, with repeated windows converging along their edges. Seen from below, a nearby corner grows longer.

chapters.title: 檐间
chapters.text: 一层屋檐越过另一层，暗面与亮色各自留下边缘。天空从这些交叠的轮廓之间显出来。
chapters.textEn: One eave crosses another; dark surfaces and brighter colours keep their separate edges. Sky appears between their overlapping outlines.

chapters.title: 头顶
chapters.text: 弧窗重复，桥底的格子向远处收小。视线沿结构延伸，到最后又遇到屋顶以外的河岸。
chapters.textEn: Arched windows repeat, and the bridge grid grows smaller in the distance. The eye follows the structure until it meets the bank beyond it.
